cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Modular Manufacturing Designer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Design and develop modular components and systems for manufacturing processes, considering functionality, efficiency, scalability, and sustainability.
Utilize CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Revit, AutoCAD) to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of modular components, ensuring accuracy and manufacturability.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to analyze design requirements, evaluate design feasibility, and identify opportunities for optimization.
Conduct research on materials, manufacturing techniques, and industry trends to inform the design process and enhance the performance of modular solutions.
Generate comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, bill of materials (BOM), and assembly instructions, to support the manufacturing and assembly of modular components.
Provide technical support to production teams during manufacturing, assembly, and installation of modular components, resolving design-related issues as needed.
Stay current on emerging technologies and best practices in modular manufacturing, continuously seeking opportunities to improve modular solutions.
Interpret piping and instrument diagrams, site layouts, equipment layouts, piping plan drawings, process flow diagrams, specifications, bills of materials, and GA drawings with respect to packaged equipment system designs.
Create 3D models and layouts including mating surfaces, finding correct library parts, performing extrusions, creating assemblies, and exploded view diagrams with BOMs.
Provide high quality outputs within schedule and manpower budget commitments.
Adhere to company policies, procedures, and safety regulations at all times, promoting a culture of compliance and excellence in modular design and manufacturing.
Other tasks as assigned by [Company name masked].
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associates degree in a technical discipline or graphics design with proven experience (3+ years) in modular design, manufacturing, or related roles
Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Revit) and other relevant design tools
Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, and assembly techniques, with a focus on modular construction methods
Experience with weldments, pipe routing, and designing skids and piping
Experience in package/plant designs and layouts with broad knowledge of technical applications, maintenance, operation, and clearance constraints of structural, mechanical, controls, and electrical equipment systems
Knowledgeable of codes typically applicable to [Company name masked] equipment including NEC, IEC, ASME, AISC, AWS, UMC, OSHA, and building codes
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines
Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and interact with stakeholders at all levels
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or related field
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to translate conceptual ideas into practical, manufacturable designs
Self-starter capable of performing all design and modeling tasks required for delivering production level drawings to purchasing and production departments with limited direction
Interest in sustainability and continuous improvement in modular manufacturing practices

In this role, you will work alongside engineers, project managers, and production staff to review and analyze customer requirements, specifications, modular construction plans, and manufacturing constraints, ensuring they meet industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal specifications. Together with the design and engineering teams, you will help ensure the seamless integration of modular solutions into manufacturing operations. These system designs include structural, mechanical, electrical, and controls sub-assemblies. Design outputs are communicated through 3D/CAD drawings for the purchase of incorporated components and manufacture of [Product name masked] products.
cond_0009.responsibilities:
Work with cross-functional teams to design and develop modular components and systems for manufacturing processes, considering functionality, efficiency, scalability, and sustainability.
Use CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Revit, AutoCAD) to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of modular components, ensuring accuracy and manufacturability.
Coordinate with engineers and other stakeholders to analyze design requirements, evaluate feasibility, and identify opportunities for optimization.
Share findings from research on materials, manufacturing techniques, and industry trends to inform the design process and improve modular solutions.
Prepare comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, bill of materials (BOM), and assembly instructions, to support manufacturing and assembly teams.
Support production teams during manufacturing, assembly, and installation of modular components, helping to resolve design-related issues as they arise.
Stay current on emerging technologies and best practices in modular manufacturing, and share ideas for improvement with the team.
Interpret piping and instrument diagrams, site layouts, equipment layouts, piping plan drawings, process flow diagrams, specifications, bills of materials, and GA drawings in relation to packaged equipment system designs.
Create 3D models and layouts including mating surfaces, library parts, extrusions, assemblies, and exploded view diagrams with BOMs.
Deliver high-quality outputs within schedule and manpower budget commitments.
Adhere to company policies, procedures, and safety regulations, supporting a culture of compliance in modular design and manufacturing.
Other tasks as assigned.
cond_0009.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associates degree in a technical discipline or graphics design with 3+ years of proven experience in modular design, manufacturing, or a related role
Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Revit) and other relevant design tools
Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, and assembly techniques, with a focus on modular construction methods
Experience with weldments, pipe routing, and designing skids and piping
Ability to interpret piping and instrument diagrams, equipment layouts, and related technical drawings
Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to translate conceptual ideas into practical, manufacturable designs
Able to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines
Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally
Able to work with limited direction and deliver production-level drawings to purchasing and production departments
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or related field
Experience in package/plant designs and layouts with broad knowledge of structural, mechanical, controls, and electrical equipment systems, including maintenance, operation, and clearance constraints
Familiarity with codes typically applicable to packaged equipment including NEC, IEC, ASME, AISC, AWS, UMC, OSHA, and relevant building codes
Interest in innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement in modular manufacturing practices

cond_0042.intro: We are looking for a Modular Manufacturing Designer to join our team at [Company name masked]. In this role, you will regularly work with cross-functional teams — engineers, project managers, and production staff — to design and optimize modular components and systems for manufacturing processes. A large part of the role is staying in close contact with design and engineering teams to review and clarify customer requirements, specifications, modular construction plans, and manufacturing constraints, making sure designs meet industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal specifications. System designs cover structural, mechanical, electrical, and controls sub-assemblies. Design outputs are communicated through 3D/CAD drawings for purchasing and production of [Company name masked] products.
cond_0042.responsibilities:
Design and develop modular components and systems for manufacturing processes, considering functionality, efficiency, scalability, and sustainability.
Use CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Revit, AutoCAD) to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of modular components, ensuring accuracy and manufacturability.
Work closely with engineers and other stakeholders daily to analyze design requirements, evaluate feasibility, and identify opportunities for optimization.
Research materials, manufacturing techniques, and industry trends to inform the design process and improve modular solutions.
Generate documentation including design specifications, bill of materials (BOM), and assembly instructions to support manufacturing and assembly.
Provide technical support to production teams during manufacturing, assembly, and installation of modular components, actively engaging with the team to resolve design-related issues as they come up.
Stay current on emerging technologies and best practices in modular manufacturing, and bring ideas forward to improve modular solutions.
Interpret piping and instrument diagrams, site layouts, equipment layouts, piping plan drawings, process flow diagrams, specifications, bills of materials, and GA drawings with respect to packaged equipment system designs.
Create 3D models and layouts including mating surfaces, finding correct library parts, performing extrusions, creating assemblies, and exploded view diagrams with BOMs.
Deliver high-quality outputs within schedule and manpower budget commitments.
Follow company policies, procedures, and safety regulations, contributing to a culture of compliance and quality in modular design and manufacturing.
Other tasks as assigned by [Company name masked].
cond_0042.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Revit) and other relevant design tools.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, and assembly techniques, with a focus on modular construction methods.
Experience with weldments, pipe routing, and designing skids and piping.
Experience in package/plant designs and layouts with broad knowledge of technical applications, maintenance, operation, and clearance constraints of structural, mechanical, controls, and electrical equipment systems.
Knowledgeable of codes typically applicable to [Company name masked] equipment including NEC, IEC, ASME, AISC, AWS, UMC, OSHA, and building codes.
Associates degree in a technical discipline or graphics design with proven experience (3+ years) in modular design, manufacturing, or a related role.
Able to work independently and deliver production-level drawings to purchasing and production departments with limited direction.

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or related field.
Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to translate conceptual ideas into practical, manufacturable designs.
Clear communication and collaboration skills, with comfort working cross-functionally and interacting with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.
Interest in innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement in modular manufacturing practices.

cond_0059.intro: As a Designer at [Company name masked] you will be involved in conceptualizing, designing, and optimizing modular components and systems for manufacturing processes. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including engineers, project managers, and production staff, to ensure the seamless integration of modular solutions into our manufacturing operations. You will work closely with our design and engineering teams to review and analyze customer requirements, specifications, modular construction plans, manufacturing constraints, ensuring they meet industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal specifications. These system designs include the appropriate structural, mechanical, electrical, and controls sub-assemblies. Design outputs are communicated through 3D/CAD drawings for the purchase of incorporated components and manufacture of [Company name masked] products. Most people become stronger in this kind of design work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0059.responsibilities:
Design and develop modular components and systems for manufacturing processes, considering factors such as functionality, efficiency, scalability, and sustainability.
Utilize CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Revit, AutoCAD) to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of modular components, ensuring accuracy and manufacturability.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to analyze design requirements, evaluate design feasibility, and identify opportunities for optimization.
Conduct thorough research on materials, manufacturing techniques, and industry trends to inform the design process and enhance the performance of modular solutions.
Generate comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, bill of materials (BOM), and assembly instructions, to support the manufacturing and assembly of modular components.
Provide technical support and expertise to production teams during the manufacturing, assembly, and installation of modular components, resolving design-related issues as needed.
Stay abreast of emerging technologies and best practices in modular manufacturing, continuously seeking opportunities to innovate and improve our modular solutions.
Interprets piping and instrument diagrams, site layouts, equipment layouts, piping plan drawings, process flow diagrams, specifications, bills of materials, and GA drawings with respect to packaged equipment system designs.
Creates 3D models and layouts including mating surfaces, finding correct library parts, performing extrusions, creating assemblies, exploded view diagrams with BOM's.
Provide high quality outputs within schedule and manpower budget commitments.
Adhere to company policies, procedures, and safety regulations at all times, promoting a culture of compliance and excellence in modular design and manufacturing.

cond_0112.intro: As a Designer at [Company name masked] you will be involved in conceptualizing, designing, and optimizing modular components and systems for manufacturing processes. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including engineers, project managers, and production staff, to ensure the seamless integration of modular solutions into our manufacturing operations. You will work closely with our design and engineering teams to review and analyze customer requirements, specifications, modular construction plans, manufacturing constraints, ensuring they meet industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal specifications. Your expertise will contribute to the seamless execution of projects, driving efficiency, and excellence in our modular construction processes. These system designs include the appropriate structural, mechanical, electrical, and controls sub-assemblies. Design outputs are communicated through 3D/CAD drawings for the purchase of incorporated components and manufacture of [Company name masked] products. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of modular system design and how the structural, mechanical, and electrical elements fit together.

Design and develop innovative modular components and systems for manufacturing processes, considering factors such as functionality, efficiency, scalability, and sustainability.
Utilize CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Revit, AutoCAD) to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of modular components, ensuring accuracy and manufacturability.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to analyze design requirements, evaluate design feasibility, and identify opportunities for optimization.
Conduct thorough research on materials, manufacturing techniques, and industry trends to inform the design process and enhance the performance of modular solutions.
Generate comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, bill of materials (BOM), and assembly instructions, to support the manufacturing and assembly of modular components.

cond_0146.intro: As a Designer at [Company name masked] you will be conceptualizing, designing, and optimizing modular components and systems for manufacturing processes. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including engineers, project managers, and production staff, to ensure the seamless integration of modular solutions into our manufacturing operations. You will work closely with our design and engineering teams to review and analyze customer requirements, specifications, modular construction plans, manufacturing constraints, ensuring they meet industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal specifications. Your expertise will contribute to the seamless execution of projects, driving efficiency, and excellence in our modular construction processes. These system designs include the appropriate structural, mechanical, electrical, and controls sub-assemblies. Design outputs are communicated through 3D/CAD drawings for the purchase of incorporated components and manufacture of [Product name masked] products.
cond_0146.responsibilities:
Design and develop innovative modular components and systems for manufacturing processes, considering factors such as functionality, efficiency, scalability, and sustainability.
Utilize CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Revit, AutoCAD) to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of modular components, ensuring accuracy and manufacturability.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to analyze design requirements, evaluate design feasibility, and identify opportunities for optimization.
Conduct thorough research on materials, manufacturing techniques, and industry trends to inform the design process and enhance the performance of modular solutions.
Generate comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, bill of materials (BOM), and assembly instructions, to support the manufacturing and assembly of modular components.
Provide technical support and expertise to production teams during the manufacturing, assembly, and installation of modular components, resolving design-related issues as needed.
Stay abreast of emerging technologies and best practices in modular manufacturing, continuously seeking opportunities to innovate and improve our modular solutions.
Interprets piping and instrument diagrams, site layouts, equipment layouts, piping plan drawings, process flow diagrams, specifications, bills of materials, and GA drawings with respect to packaged equipment system designs.
Creates 3D models and layouts including mating surfaces, finding correct library parts, performing extrusions, creating assemblies, exploded view diagrams with BOM's.
Provide high quality outputs within schedule and manpower budget commitments.
Adhere to company policies, procedures, and safety regulations at all times, promoting a culture of compliance and excellence in modular design and manufacturing.
Other tasks as assigned by [Company name masked].
cond_0146.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's degree in a technical discipline or graphics design with proven experience (3+ years) in modular design, manufacturing, or related roles
Deep knowledge of CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Revit) and other relevant design tools
Extensive knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, and assembly techniques, with a focus on modular construction methods
Demonstrated expertise in weldments, pipe routing, and designing skids and piping
Substantial experience in package/plant designs and layouts with broad knowledge of technical applications, maintenance, operation, and clearance constraints of structural, mechanical, controls, and electrical equipment systems
Advanced knowledge of codes typically applicable to [Company name masked] equipment including NEC, IEC, ASME, AISC, AWS, UMC, OSHA, and building codes
Proven ability to work as a self-starter, capable of performing all design and modeling tasks required for delivering production-level drawings to purchasing and production departments with limited direction
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or related field; advanced degree strongly preferred
Exceptional problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with a proven track record of translating conceptual ideas into practical, manufacturable designs
Strong leadership and communication abilities, with demonstrated success working cross-functionally and interacting with stakeholders at all levels
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines
Solid understanding of innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement practices in modular manufacturing

cond_0172.intro: We are looking for a Modular Manufacturing Designer to join our team.
cond_0172.responsibilities:
Design and develop modular components and systems for manufacturing processes, considering functionality, efficiency, scalability, and sustainability.
Utilize CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Revit, AutoCAD) to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of modular components, ensuring accuracy and manufacturability.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to analyze design requirements, evaluate design feasibility, and identify opportunities for optimization.
Conduct research on materials, manufacturing techniques, and industry trends to inform the design process and enhance the performance of modular solutions.
Generate comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, bill of materials (BOM), and assembly instructions, to support the manufacturing and assembly of modular components.
Provide technical support to production teams during the manufacturing, assembly, and installation of modular components, resolving design-related issues as needed.
Stay current on emerging technologies and best practices in modular manufacturing, continuously seeking opportunities to innovate and improve modular solutions.
Interpret piping and instrument diagrams, site layouts, equipment layouts, piping plan drawings, process flow diagrams, specifications, bills of materials, and GA drawings with respect to packaged equipment system designs.
Create 3D models and layouts including mating surfaces, finding correct library parts, performing extrusions, creating assemblies, and exploded view diagrams with BOMs.
Provide high quality outputs within schedule and manpower budget commitments.
Adhere to company policies, procedures, and safety regulations at all times, promoting a culture of compliance and excellence in modular design and manufacturing.
Other tasks as assigned.
cond_0172.requirements:
Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Revit) and other relevant design tools.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, and assembly techniques, with a focus on modular construction methods.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to translate conceptual ideas into practical, manufacturable designs.
Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and interact with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.
Interest in innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement in modular manufacturing practices.
Experience with weldments, pipe routing, and designing skids and piping.
Experience in package/plant designs and layouts with broad knowledge of technical applications, maintenance, operation, and clearance constraints of structural, mechanical, controls, and electrical equipment systems.
Knowledgeable of codes typically applicable to equipment including NEC, IEC, ASME, AISC, AWS, UMC, OSHA, and building codes.
A self-starter capable of performing all design and modeling tasks required for delivering production level drawings to purchasing and production departments with limited direction.
Associates degree in a technical discipline or graphics design with proven experience (3+ years) in modular design, manufacturing, or related roles.
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or related field.

cond_0219.intro: We are looking for a Modular Manufacturing Designer to join our team.
cond_0219.responsibilities:
Design and develop modular components and systems for manufacturing processes, considering functionality, efficiency, scalability, and sustainability.
Utilize CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Revit, AutoCAD) to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of modular components, ensuring accuracy and manufacturability.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to analyze design requirements, evaluate design feasibility, and identify opportunities for optimization.
Conduct research on materials, manufacturing techniques, and industry trends to inform the design process and enhance the performance of modular solutions.
Generate comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, bill of materials (BOM), and assembly instructions, to support the manufacturing and assembly of modular components.
Provide technical support to production teams during the manufacturing, assembly, and installation of modular components, resolving design-related issues as needed.
Stay current on emerging technologies and best practices in modular manufacturing, continuously seeking opportunities to innovate and improve modular solutions.
Interpret piping and instrument diagrams, site layouts, equipment layouts, piping plan drawings, process flow diagrams, specifications, bills of materials, and GA drawings with respect to packaged equipment system designs.
Create 3D models and layouts including mating surfaces, finding correct library parts, performing extrusions, creating assemblies, and exploded view diagrams with BOMs.
Provide high quality outputs within schedule and manpower budget commitments.
Adhere to company policies, procedures, and safety regulations at all times, promoting a culture of compliance and excellence in modular design and manufacturing.
Other tasks as assigned by [Company name masked].
cond_0219.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience with CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Revit) and other relevant design tools.
Associate's degree in a technical discipline or graphics design, or equivalent practical experience, with around 3 or more years of experience in modular design, manufacturing, or a related role.
Experience with weldments, pipe routing, and designing skids and piping.
Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, and assembly techniques, with a focus on modular construction methods.
Familiarity with codes typically applicable to equipment including NEC, IEC, ASME, AISC, AWS, UMC, OSHA, and building codes.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Background in package/plant designs and layouts, with exposure to technical applications, maintenance, operation, and clearance constraints of structural, mechanical, controls, and electrical equipment systems.
Ability to work independently on design and modeling tasks, delivering production-level drawings to purchasing and production departments with limited direction.
Ability to communicate effectively and work cross-functionally with stakeholders at various levels.
Willingness to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.
Openness to continuous improvement and interest in sustainability in modular manufacturing practices.

cond_0227.intro: We are looking for a Modular Manufacturing Designer to join our team.
cond_0227.responsibilities:
Design and develop innovative modular components and systems for manufacturing processes, considering factors such as functionality, efficiency, scalability, and sustainability.
Utilize CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Revit, AutoCAD) to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of modular components, ensuring accuracy and manufacturability.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to analyze design requirements, evaluate design feasibility, and identify opportunities for optimization.
Conduct thorough research on materials, manufacturing techniques, and industry trends to inform the design process and enhance the performance of modular solutions.
Generate comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, bill of materials (BOM), and assembly instructions, to support the manufacturing and assembly of modular components.
Provide technical support and expertise to production teams during the manufacturing, assembly, and installation of modular components, resolving design-related issues as needed.
Stay abreast of emerging technologies and best practices in modular manufacturing, continuously seeking opportunities to innovate and improve our modular solutions.
Interprets piping and instrument diagrams, site layouts, equipment layouts, piping plan drawings, process flow diagrams, specifications, bills of materials, and GA drawings with respect to packaged equipment system designs.
Creates 3D models and layouts including mating surfaces, finding correct library parts, performing extrusions, creating assemblies, exploded view diagrams with BOM's.
Provide high quality outputs within schedule and manpower budget commitments.
Adhere to company policies, procedures, and safety regulations at all times, promoting a culture of compliance and excellence in modular design and manufacturing.
Other tasks as assigned.
cond_0227.requirements:
Deep expertise in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Revit) and other relevant design tools.
Advanced knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, and assembly techniques, with a focus on modular construction methods.
Exceptional problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to translate conceptual ideas into practical, manufacturable designs.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and interact with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.
Proven track record with weldments, pipe routing, and designing skids and piping.
Extensive experience in package/plant designs and layouts with deep knowledge of technical applications, maintenance, operation, and clearance constraints of structural, mechanical, controls, and electrical equipment systems.
Advanced knowledge of codes typically applicable to equipment including NEC, IEC, ASME, AISC, AWS, UMC, OSHA, and building codes.
A self-starter with demonstrated expertise performing all design and modeling tasks required for delivering production level drawings to purchasing and production departments with limited direction.
Associate's degree in a technical discipline or graphic design required, with a minimum of 3 years of demonstrated expertise in modular design, manufacturing, or a related role; Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or related field strongly preferred.

cond_0235.intro: We are looking for a Modular Manufacturing Designer to join our team.
cond_0235.responsibilities:
Design and develop modular components and systems for manufacturing processes, considering functionality, efficiency, scalability, and sustainability.
Utilize CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Revit, AutoCAD) to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of modular components, ensuring accuracy and manufacturability.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to analyze design requirements, evaluate design feasibility, and identify opportunities for optimization.
Conduct research on materials, manufacturing techniques, and industry trends to inform the design process and enhance the performance of modular solutions.
Generate comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, bill of materials (BOM), and assembly instructions, to support the manufacturing and assembly of modular components.
Provide technical support to production teams during manufacturing, assembly, and installation of modular components, resolving design-related issues as needed.
Stay current on emerging technologies and best practices in modular manufacturing, continuously seeking opportunities to improve modular solutions.
Interpret piping and instrument diagrams, site layouts, equipment layouts, piping plan drawings, process flow diagrams, specifications, bills of materials, and GA drawings with respect to packaged equipment system designs.
Create 3D models and layouts including mating surfaces, finding correct library parts, performing extrusions, creating assemblies, and exploded view diagrams with BOMs.
Provide high quality outputs within schedule and manpower budget commitments.
Adhere to company policies, procedures, and safety regulations at all times, promoting a culture of compliance and excellence in modular design and manufacturing.
Other tasks as assigned by [Company name masked].
cond_0235.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associates degree in a technical discipline or graphics design with proven experience (3+ years) in modular design, manufacturing, or related roles
Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Revit) and other relevant design tools
Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, and assembly techniques, with a focus on modular construction methods
Experience with weldments, pipe routing, and designing skids and piping
Experience in package/plant designs and layouts with broad knowledge of technical applications, maintenance, operation, and clearance constraints of structural, mechanical, controls, and electrical equipment systems
Knowledgeable of codes typically applicable to [Company name masked] equipment including NEC, IEC, ASME, AISC, AWS, UMC, OSHA, and building codes
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines
Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and interact with stakeholders at all levels
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or related field
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to translate conceptual ideas into practical, manufacturable designs
Self-starter capable of performing all design and modeling tasks required for delivering production level drawings to purchasing and production departments with limited direction
Interest in sustainability and continuous improvement in modular manufacturing practices

cond_0382.intro: As a Designer at [Company name masked] you will be involved in conceptualizing, designing, and optimizing modular components and systems for manufacturing processes. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including engineers, project managers, and production staff, to ensure the seamless integration of modular solutions into our manufacturing operations. You will work closely with our design and engineering teams to review and analyze customer requirements, specifications, modular construction plans, manufacturing constraints, ensuring they meet industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal specifications. Your expertise will contribute to the seamless execution of projects, driving efficiency, and excellence in our modular construction processes. These system designs include the appropriate structural, mechanical, electrical, and controls sub-assemblies. Design outputs are communicated through 3D/CAD drawings for the purchase of incorporated components and manufacture of [Company name masked] products. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of modular system design and how the structural, mechanical, and electrical elements fit together.
cond_0382.responsibilities:
Design and develop innovative modular components and systems for manufacturing processes, considering factors such as functionality, efficiency, scalability, and sustainability.
Utilize CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Revit, AutoCAD) to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of modular components, ensuring accuracy and manufacturability.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to analyze design requirements, evaluate design feasibility, and identify opportunities for optimization.
Conduct thorough research on materials, manufacturing techniques, and industry trends to inform the design process and enhance the performance of modular solutions.
Generate comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, bill of materials (BOM), and assembly instructions, to support the manufacturing and assembly of modular components.
Provide technical support and expertise to production teams during the manufacturing, assembly, and installation of modular components, resolving design-related issues as needed.
Stay abreast of emerging technologies and best practices in modular manufacturing, continuously seeking opportunities to innovate and improve our modular solutions.
Interprets piping and instrument diagrams, site layouts, equipment layouts, piping plan drawings, process flow diagrams, specifications, bills of materials, and GA drawings with respect to packaged equipment system designs.
Creates 3D models and layouts including mating surfaces, finding correct library parts, performing extrusions, creating assemblies, exploded view diagrams with BOM's.
Provide high quality outputs within schedule and manpower budget commitments.
Adhere to company policies, procedures, and safety regulations at all times, promoting a culture of compliance and excellence in modular design and manufacturing.
Other tasks as assigned by [Company name masked].
cond_0382.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associates degree in a technical discipline or graphics design with proven experience (3+ years) in modular design, manufacturing, or related roles
Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Revit) and other relevant design tools
Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, and assembly techniques, with a focus on modular construction methods
Experience with weldments, pipe routing, and designing skids and piping
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to translate conceptual ideas into practical, manufacturable designs
Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and interact with stakeholders at all levels of the organization
A self-starter capable of performing all design and modeling tasks required for delivering production level drawings to purchasing and production departments with limited direction
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or related field
Experience in package/plant designs and layouts with broad knowledge of technical applications, maintenance, operation, and clearance constraints of structural, mechanical, controls, and electrical equipment systems
Knowledgeable of codes typically applicable to [Company name masked] equipment including NEC, IEC, ASME, AISC, AWS, UMC, OSHA, and building codes etc.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines
Interest in innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement in modular manufacturing practices

cond_0455.intro: As a Designer at [Company name masked] you will be involved in conceptualizing, designing, and optimizing modular components and systems for manufacturing processes. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including engineers, project managers, and production staff, to ensure the seamless integration of modular solutions into our manufacturing operations. You will work closely with our design and engineering teams to review and analyze customer requirements, specifications, modular construction plans, manufacturing constraints, ensuring they meet industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal specifications. These system designs include the appropriate structural, mechanical, electrical, and controls sub-assemblies. Design outputs are communicated through 3D/CAD drawings for the purchase of incorporated components and manufacture of [Company name masked] products. Most people become stronger in this kind of design work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0455.responsibilities:
Design and develop modular components and systems for manufacturing processes, considering factors such as functionality, efficiency, scalability, and sustainability.
Utilize CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Revit, AutoCAD) to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of modular components, ensuring accuracy and manufacturability.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to analyze design requirements, evaluate design feasibility, and identify opportunities for optimization.
Conduct thorough research on materials, manufacturing techniques, and industry trends to inform the design process and enhance the performance of modular solutions.
Generate comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, bill of materials (BOM), and assembly instructions, to support the manufacturing and assembly of modular components.
Provide technical support and expertise to production teams during the manufacturing, assembly, and installation of modular components, resolving design-related issues as needed.
Stay abreast of emerging technologies and best practices in modular manufacturing, continuously seeking opportunities to innovate and improve our modular solutions.
Interprets piping and instrument diagrams, site layouts, equipment layouts, piping plan drawings, process flow diagrams, specifications, bills of materials, and GA drawings with respect to packaged equipment system designs.
Creates 3D models and layouts including mating surfaces, finding correct library parts, performing extrusions, creating assemblies, exploded view diagrams with BOM's.
Provide high quality outputs within schedule and manpower budget commitments.
Adhere to company policies, procedures, and safety regulations at all times, promoting a culture of compliance and excellence in modular design and manufacturing.

cond_0472.intro: As a Designer at [Company name masked] you will be involved in conceptualizing, designing, and optimizing modular components and systems for manufacturing processes. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including engineers, project managers, and production staff, to ensure the seamless integration of modular solutions into our manufacturing operations. You will work closely with our design and engineering teams to review and analyze customer requirements, specifications, modular construction plans, manufacturing constraints, ensuring they meet industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal specifications. Your expertise will contribute to the seamless execution of projects, driving efficiency, and excellence in our modular construction processes. These system designs include the appropriate structural, mechanical, electrical, and controls sub-assemblies. Design outputs are communicated through 3D/CAD drawings for the purchase of incorporated components and manufacture of [Company name masked] products. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of modular system design and how the structural, mechanical, and electrical elements fit together.
cond_0472.responsibilities:
Design and develop innovative modular components and systems for manufacturing processes, considering factors such as functionality, efficiency, scalability, and sustainability.
Utilize CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Revit, AutoCAD) to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of modular components, ensuring accuracy and manufacturability.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to analyze design requirements, evaluate design feasibility, and identify opportunities for optimization.
Conduct thorough research on materials, manufacturing techniques, and industry trends to inform the design process and enhance the performance of modular solutions.
Generate comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, bill of materials (BOM), and assembly instructions, to support the manufacturing and assembly of modular components.
Provide technical support and expertise to production teams during the manufacturing, assembly, and installation of modular components, resolving design-related issues as needed.
Stay abreast of emerging technologies and best practices in modular manufacturing, continuously seeking opportunities to innovate and improve our modular solutions.
Interprets piping and instrument diagrams, site layouts, equipment layouts, piping plan drawings, process flow diagrams, specifications, bills of materials, and GA drawings with respect to packaged equipment system designs.
Creates 3D models and layouts including mating surfaces, finding correct library parts, performing extrusions, creating assemblies, exploded view diagrams with BOM's.
Provide high quality outputs within schedule and manpower budget commitments.
Adhere to company policies, procedures, and safety regulations at all times, promoting a culture of compliance and excellence in modular design and manufacturing.
Other tasks as assigned by [Company name masked].
cond_0472.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associates degree in a technical discipline or graphics design with proven experience (3+ years) in modular design, manufacturing, or related roles
Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Revit) and other relevant design tools
Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, and assembly techniques, with a focus on modular construction methods
Experience with weldments, pipe routing, and designing skids and piping
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to translate conceptual ideas into practical, manufacturable designs
Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and interact with stakeholders at all levels of the organization
A self-starter capable of performing all design and modeling tasks required for delivering production level drawings to purchasing and production departments with limited direction
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or related field
Experience in package/plant designs and layouts with broad knowledge of technical applications, maintenance, operation, and clearance constraints of structural, mechanical, controls, and electrical equipment systems
Knowledgeable of codes typically applicable to [Company name masked] equipment including NEC, IEC, ASME, AISC, AWS, UMC, OSHA, and building codes etc.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines
Interest in innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement in modular manufacturing practices

cond_0498.responsibilities:
Design and develop modular components and systems for manufacturing processes, considering functionality, efficiency, scalability, and sustainability.
Utilize CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Revit, AutoCAD) to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of modular components, ensuring accuracy and manufacturability.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to analyze design requirements, evaluate design feasibility, and identify opportunities for optimization.
Conduct research on materials, manufacturing techniques, and industry trends to inform the design process and enhance the performance of modular solutions.
Generate comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, bill of materials (BOM), and assembly instructions, to support the manufacturing and assembly of modular components.
Provide technical support to production teams during the manufacturing, assembly, and installation of modular components, resolving design-related issues as needed.
Stay current on emerging technologies and best practices in modular manufacturing, continuously seeking opportunities to improve modular solutions.
Interpret piping and instrument diagrams, site layouts, equipment layouts, piping plan drawings, process flow diagrams, specifications, bills of materials, and GA drawings with respect to packaged equipment system designs.
Create 3D models and layouts including mating surfaces, finding correct library parts, performing extrusions, creating assemblies, exploded view diagrams with BOMs.
Provide high quality outputs within schedule and manpower budget commitments.
Adhere to company policies, procedures, and safety regulations at all times, promoting a culture of compliance and excellence in modular design and manufacturing.
Other tasks as assigned by [Company name masked].
cond_0498.requirements:
Experience with CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Revit) and other relevant design tools.
Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, and assembly techniques, with a focus on modular construction methods.
Ability to communicate effectively and work cross-functionally with stakeholders at various levels of the organization.
Comfort managing multiple projects, prioritizing tasks, and meeting deadlines.
Openness to continuous improvement and an interest in sustainability and innovation in modular manufacturing practices.
Experience with weldments, pipe routing, and designing skids and piping.
Background in package/plant designs and layouts, with familiarity with technical applications, maintenance, operation, and clearance constraints of structural, mechanical, controls, and electrical equipment systems.

Associate's degree in a technical discipline or graphic design, or equivalent practical experience, with around 3 or more years of experience in modular design, manufacturing, or a related role; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

cond_0638.intro: We are looking for a Modular Manufacturing Designer to join our team at [Company name masked]. In this role, you will own the conceptualization, design, and optimization of modular components and systems for manufacturing processes. You will lead close coordination with cross-functional teams — including engineers, project managers, and production staff — to drive the seamless integration of modular solutions into manufacturing operations. You will independently review and analyze customer requirements, specifications, modular construction plans, and manufacturing constraints, ensuring they meet industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal specifications. These system designs include structural, mechanical, electrical, and controls sub-assemblies. Design outputs are delivered through 3D/CAD drawings to support component purchasing and product manufacture.
cond_0638.responsibilities:
Design and develop modular components and systems for manufacturing processes, taking ownership of functionality, efficiency, scalability, and sustainability decisions.
Execute detailed 3D models and technical drawings of modular components using CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Revit, AutoCAD), ensuring accuracy and manufacturability.
Lead analysis of design requirements with engineers and other stakeholders, evaluate design feasibility, and determine opportunities for optimization.
Drive thorough research on materials, manufacturing techniques, and industry trends to inform the design process and improve modular solutions.
Produce comprehensive documentation — including design specifications, bill of materials (BOM), and assembly instructions — to support manufacturing and assembly.
Deliver technical support and expertise to production teams during manufacturing, assembly, and installation of modular components, resolving design-related issues directly.
Proactively identify and pursue emerging technologies and best practices in modular manufacturing to continuously improve modular solutions.
Interpret piping and instrument diagrams, site layouts, equipment layouts, piping plan drawings, process flow diagrams, specifications, bills of materials, and GA drawings with respect to packaged equipment system designs.
Create 3D models and layouts including mating surfaces, finding correct library parts, performing extrusions, creating assemblies, and exploded view diagrams with BOMs.
Deliver high-quality outputs within schedule and manpower budget commitments.
Adhere to company policies, procedures, and safety regulations at all times, promoting a culture of compliance and excellence in modular design and manufacturing.

cond_0648.intro: As a Designer at [Company name masked], you will work alongside cross-functional teams — including engineers, project managers, and production staff — to help conceptualize, design, and optimize modular components and systems for manufacturing processes. Working closely with our design and engineering teams, you will help review and analyze customer requirements, specifications, modular construction plans, and manufacturing constraints, ensuring they meet industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal specifications. These system designs include the appropriate structural, mechanical, electrical, and controls sub-assemblies. Design outputs are communicated through 3D/CAD drawings for the purchase of incorporated components and manufacture of [Company name masked] products.
cond_0648.responsibilities:
Coordinate with engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to design and develop modular components and systems, considering functionality, efficiency, scalability, and sustainability.
Use CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Revit, AutoCAD) to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of modular components, ensuring accuracy and manufacturability.
Work with engineers and other stakeholders to analyze design requirements, evaluate feasibility, and identify opportunities for optimization.
Conduct research on materials, manufacturing techniques, and industry trends to support the design process and improve modular solutions.
Prepare comprehensive documentation — including design specifications, bill of materials (BOM), and assembly instructions — to support manufacturing and assembly teams.
Support production teams during manufacturing, assembly, and installation of modular components, helping to resolve design-related issues as they arise.
Stay current on emerging technologies and best practices in modular manufacturing, sharing findings to help improve modular solutions.
Interpret piping and instrument diagrams, site layouts, equipment layouts, piping plan drawings, process flow diagrams, specifications, bills of materials, and GA drawings with respect to packaged equipment system designs.
Create 3D models and layouts including mating surfaces, finding correct library parts, performing extrusions, creating assemblies, and exploded view diagrams with BOMs.
Deliver high-quality outputs within schedule and manpower budget commitments.
Follow company policies, procedures, and safety regulations, supporting a culture of compliance in modular design and manufacturing.
Other tasks as assigned by [Company name masked].
cond_0648.requirements:
Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Revit) and other relevant design tools.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, and assembly techniques, with a focus on modular construction methods.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to translate conceptual ideas into practical, manufacturable designs.
Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and interact with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.
Interest in innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement in modular manufacturing practices.
Experience with weldments, pipe routing, and designing skids and piping.
Experience in package/plant designs and layouts with broad knowledge of technical applications, maintenance, operation, and clearance constraints of structural, mechanical, controls, and electrical equipment systems.
Knowledgeable of codes typically applicable to [Company name masked] equipment including NEC, IEC, ASME, AISC, AWS, UMC, OSHA, and building codes etc.
A self-starter and skilled designer capable of performing all design and modeling tasks required for delivering production level drawings to purchasing and production departments with limited direction.
